equivalence_gate.frame_match: both null, or both finite with |diff| <= 1e-6
equivalence_gate.on_fail: stop; no variant results are produced or reported

baseline.name: mirror baseline
baseline.change: none (core hrv.rs respiratory(): cumulative-RR time axis, 4Hz linear interp with last-interval NaN, Welch no detrend, band [0.15,0.4], rate gate [6,40], median of 5)

judgement.a_mae: paired diff (variant - V0) pooled MAE over 68 records: CI upper < 0, or independent CIs non-overlapping with variant lower
judgement.b_coverage: pooled coverage drop <= 5 percentage points, also within each dataset
judgement.c_strata: per (dataset, stratum) with n_rec >= 10: MAE point diff <= 0; n_rec < 10 cells reported as uninterpretable and excluded
judgement.d_mae_pen: report paired CI of MAE_pen; if lower bound > 0 (significantly worse) label is 'not improved (MAE_pen worse)'

variants.name: interp-end-hold
variants.hypothesis: Last Welch segment is zeroed by the NaN tail (hrv.rs:176, :283-285); holding the last RR value removes the NaN and lets the newest ~18-35 s contribute to the spectrum.
variants.change: last interval y2 undefined -> use y1 (hold last value)

variants.name: interp-end-truncate
variants.hypothesis: Same defect, handled by excluding the last interval instead of extrapolating.
variants.change: drop 4Hz points after t[n-1] (start of last RR)

variants.name: band-lo-0.10
variants.hypothesis: Slow breathing (6-9/min) is outside [0.15,0.4]; BIDMC/MARSH 6-12 stratum shows bias +1.7~+1.8.

variants.name: band-lo-0.08
variants.hypothesis: Wider lower bound, observation only; peaks below 0.1 Hz fail the unchanged rate>=6 gate and become null.

variants.name: time-axis-real-beat-start
variants.hypothesis: Cumulative-RR axis compresses time where beats were removed by refinement (rate inflated ~1/(1-p)); the real beat start time removes that compression.
variants.change: value i at (ts[i]-rr[i])-(ts[0]-rr[0]); end at ts[n-1]-(ts[0]-rr[0]); non-monotone frames fall back to cumulative and are counted

variants.name: detrend-mean-linear
variants.hypothesis: No mean/trend removal before Welch lets LF drift leak into the 0.15 Hz band edge.
variants.change: least-squares mean + linear trend removal on finite 4Hz points before Welch

variants.name: band-hi-0.5
variants.hypothesis: Rates above 24/min cannot be detected with hi=0.4; >20 stratum bias is about -8~-9.

variants.name: peak-continuity
variants.hypothesis: Single max-bin pick jumps between competing peaks; a continuity prior stabilises it.
variants.change: prefer the max bin within +-0.04 Hz of previous dominant frequency if its PSD >= 0.5 x global band max; reset on failure/reset

gates.G_resp: V0 mirror resp == core C0 resp (A8-2)
gates.G_front: PPG front-end mirror RR/ts == core rr_list/rr_end_ts (rr tol 1e-6 ms, ts tol 1e-3 ms; total<=0.1%, per-record<=1%); required for W1,W1b,W3,W5

multiplicity.note: reference only; judgement uses addendum-8 rules

variants.name: sqi-gate-70
variants.change: core ppg_sqi mean over analysis window <70 -> do not buffer RR candidates; output null for resp/HR_rr/SDNN/RMSSD that frame

variants.name: refine-pm30
variants.change: median gate width 0.25 -> 0.30 (candidate gate, retro cleanup, reseed seed)

variants.name: refine-malik20
variants.change: candidate vs previous accepted RR >20% -> reject; no retro cleanup; reseed streak unchanged

variants.name: refine-local-median11
variants.change: candidate gate vs median of last 11 buffered RR when buffer>=5

variants.name: peak-parabolic
variants.change: 3-point parabolic sub-sample peak refinement; RR and ts from refined peak positions; candidate set unchanged

variants.name: detrend-slope-only
variants.change: Welch pre-step linear-slope removal only (mean kept)

variants.name: V4+W3 combination (only combination in this phase)

phase4_holdout.inherits: addendum-8 judgement/statistics unchanged; addendum-9 A9-4 HRV report
phase4_holdout.freeze_note: freeze.sha/tree hashes are recorded in the approval commit that follows the freeze commit (cannot self-reference)
